name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Sen. Mark Warner slams Trump's primetime speech: "Incredible lies"
changes.summary: Sen. Mark Warner joins CBS News with his reaction to President Trump's primetime address on Thursday about U.S. election security.

changes.title: Trump administration to declassify documents relating to China and U.S. elections
changes.summary: President Donald Trump addressed the nation from the White House, announcing that the administration will declassify documents related to the 2020 election and alleged influence by China.

changes.title: An analysis of President Trump's address
changes.summary: President Trump gave a primetime address Thursday night in which he spoke about the integrity of U.S. elections — a topic he has spread disinformation about for much of his political career.

changes.title: What to Know About Trump’s Attacks on Mail Voting
changes.summary: Many of President Trump’s attempts to curtail mail voting have been blocked by the courts. Before Trump, Republicans actually embraced absentee voting.

changes.title: Trump speaks on elections, alleges Chinese access to voter data | Special Report
changes.summary: President Trump on Thursday delivered a primetime address about election security where he railed against China. Tony Dokoupil anchored CBS News' special report.

changes.title: Fact checking Trump speech on election security
changes.summary: President Trump is delivering a speech on election security Thursday night at the White House.

changes.title: How paper ballots make digital manipulation of results unlikely
changes.summary: NBC News’ Jane Timm analyzes President Trump’s claims about digital manipulation of ballot results in the U.S., as Trump said that the White House will declassify documents related to the 2020 election and alleged influence by China during his speech to the nation.

changes.title: Trump again makes unverifiable claims of noncitizen voting
changes.summary: The president offered no concrete evidence, and at least one state — Nevada — rejected his claims immediately.

changes.title: Rep. Jim Himes reacts to Trump's speech on election security
changes.summary: NPR's A Martinez discusses President Trump's speech on election security with Connecticut Rep. Jim Himes, the ranking Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee.

changes.title: World leaders meet in D.C. to discuss left-wing political violence
changes.summary: Leaders from roughly 60 countries gathered in Washington, DC, to discuss what top Trump administration officials are calling an urgent threat: far left terrorism.
